Mes Factures bundles the following open-source software:
- swissqrbill (MIT) - Roger Schönbächler - QR-bill data, validation, translations and layout reference
- QR Code generator library (MIT) - Project Nayuki
- pdf-lib (MIT) - Andrew Dillon
- pdf.js (Apache-2.0) - Mozilla
- React (MIT) - Meta Platforms
- Lucide icons via react-icons (ISC / MIT)
